snippet.title: Lythravel | Official Gameplay Trailer | Free-to-Play Browser MMORPG
snippet.description:
Two continents at war. Six classes. Open-world PvP, six dungeons, a raid for twelve and world bosses. Free to play, right in your browser.

▶ Play now: https://lythravel.com
 Join our Discord community: https://discord.gg/SdJrn5WPBQ

Lythravel is a free-to-play fantasy MMORPG that runs in your browser: no download, no install. Choose Dawn or Dusk, level from 1 to 50, ride out with your party and take on dungeons, raids and the other side.

WHAT'S IN THE GAME
• Two continents, Dawn and Dusk, six zones each, levels 1-50
• Six classes, each with its own signature skills and ultimates
• Open-world PvP in the Riftlands, plus battlegrounds
• Six dungeons and the Sanctum of the Shattering, a raid for twelve players
• World bosses that take a whole war party
• Mounts, guilds, an auction house, crafting and trading
• Veteran and Mythic modes, Mythic with permadeath

Everything in this trailer was captured in-game.
